panels.what: A rain city at dusk. Prices in tokens glow on every wall like shop signs.
One small tuk-tuk at the curb, its little lamp on.
Biju, in the driver's seat, eats a slice of mango. Calm.
A passenger climbs into the back, soaked, staring at a phone.
The phone: a number counting down fast, in red.
The passenger's face, lit red.
The number hits zero.

line.text: I had a year in there.
I had a year in there.

panels.what: Biju looks in the little mirror. Says nothing.
Biju's eyes in the mirror. Kind. Not worried at all.
Biju keeps looking. Rain drums on the roof.
Biju keeps looking. Rain drums on the roof.
Biju's hand opens the glove box.
Inside: a neat stack of paper napkins.
He takes one napkin. The raindrops start to stop in the air.

panels.what: A small room at The Well. Dark, except every wall is covered in glowing calendar blocks.
A clock: 4:47.
Riven, 47, sits up in bed. Already tired.
His face, lit blue by the blocks. A boy inside a 47-year-old face.
His face, lit blue by the blocks. A boy inside a 47-year-old face.
He stands and points at the blocks like a coach.
The block that says SLEEP is the smallest block on the wall.
Riven drags a block bigger with his finger. It snaps back.
He drags it again. It snaps back again.
The third time it snaps back, and a brand new block appears: PROVE IT.
Riven, smaller.
